001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel;
002
003import java.util.HashSet;
004import java.util.Set;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.ListMap;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.WeightedRandomPicker;
014
015public class SystemBountyManager extends BaseEventManager {
016
017        public static final String KEY = "$core_systemBountyManager";
018        
019        public static SystemBountyManager getInstance() {
020                Object test = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
021                return (SystemBountyManager) test; 
022        }
023        
024        public SystemBountyManager() {
025                super();
026                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
027        }
028        
029        @Override
030        protected int getMinConcurrent() {
031                return Global.getSettings().getInt("minSystemBounties");
032        }
033        @Override
034        protected int getMaxConcurrent() {
035                return Global.getSettings().getInt("maxSystemBounties");
036        }
037
038        @Override
039        protected EveryFrameScript createEvent() {
040                //if ((float) Math.random() < 0.1f) return null;
041                
042                MarketAPI market = pickMarket();
043                if (market == null) return null;
044                
045                SystemBountyIntel intel = new SystemBountyIntel(market);
046                return intel;
047        }
048        
049        
050        public boolean isActive(MarketAPI market) {
051                for (EveryFrameScript s : getActive()) {
052                        if (market == ((SystemBountyIntel)s).getMarket()) return true;
053                }
054                return false;
055        }
056        
057        public SystemBountyIntel getActive(MarketAPI market) {
058                for (EveryFrameScript s : getActive()) {
059                        SystemBountyIntel intel = (SystemBountyIntel) s;
060                        if (intel.isDone()) continue;
061                        
062                        if (market == intel.getMarket()) return intel;
063                }
064                return null;
065        }
066        
067        public void addOrResetBounty(MarketAPI market) {
068                if (market != null) {
069                        SystemBountyIntel active = getActive(market);
070                        if (active != null) {
071                                active.reset();
072                        } else {
073                                addActive(new SystemBountyIntel(market));
074                        }
075                }
076        }
077        
078        protected transient boolean alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible = false;
079        public boolean isAlwaysPickAMarketIfPossible() {
080                return alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible;
081        }
082
083        public void setAlwaysPickAMarketIfPossible(boolean alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible) {
084                this.alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible = alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible;
085        }
086
087        protected MarketAPI pickMarket() {
088                Set<MarketAPI> already = new HashSet<MarketAPI>();
089                for (EveryFrameScript s : getActive()) {
090                        already.add(((SystemBountyIntel)s).getMarket());
091                }
092                
093                ListMap<MarketAPI> locationIdToMarket = new ListMap<MarketAPI>();
094                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
095                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
096                        locationIdToMarket.add(market.getContainingLocation().getId(), market);
097                }
098                
099                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> pickerWithPirateActivity = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
100                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
101                OUTER: for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
102                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
103                        if (market.getSize() <= 4) continue;
104                        if (market.isPlayerOwned()) continue;
105                        if (already.contains(market)) continue;
106                        
107                        if (market.getFaction().getCustom().optBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_POSTS_NO_BOUNTIES)) {
108                                continue;
109                        }
110                        
111                        if (Global.getSector().isInNewGameAdvance() && market.getId().equals("jangala")) {
112                                continue; // want a fresh one to be auto-started there on game start
113                        }
114
115                        for (MarketAPI other : locationIdToMarket.getList(market.getContainingLocation().getId())) {
116                                if (market.getFaction() == other.getFaction() && already.contains(other)) {
117                                        continue OUTER;
118                                }
119                        }
120                        
121                        float w = market.getSize() * 0.25f;
122                        for (MarketAPI other : locationIdToMarket.getList(market.getContainingLocation().getId())) {
123                                if (market.getFaction().isHostileTo(other.getFaction())) {
124//                                      w += other.getSize() * 25f;
125//                                      if (other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY) ||
126//                                                      other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL)) {
127//                                              w += other.getSize() * 25f;
128//                                      }
129                                        w += 10f;
130                                        if (other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY) ||
131                                                        other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL)) {
132                                                w += 10f;
133                                        }
134                                        if (market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY)) {
135                                                w += 10f;
136                                        } else if (market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL)) {
137                                                w += 5f;
138                                        }
139                                }
140                        }
141                        
142                        if (market.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRATE_ACTIVITY)) {
143                                w += 10f;
144                                pickerWithPirateActivity.add(market, w);
145                        } else {
146                                picker.add(market, w);
147                        }
148                }
149                
150                //picker.print("Bounty weights: ");
151                
152                MarketAPI market = pickerWithPirateActivity.pick();
153                float w = pickerWithPirateActivity.getWeight(market);
154                if (market == null) {
155                        market = picker.pick();
156                        w = picker.getWeight(market);
157                }
158                
159                float probMult = 1f / (getOngoing() + 1f);
160                
161                if (!alwaysPickAMarketIfPossible && (float) Math.random() > w * 0.01f * probMult) {
162                        market = null;
163                }
164                
165                return market;
166                
167        }
168        
169}
